projects.title: Omnichannel AI-Powered Real Estate CRM
projects.description: An intelligent omnichannel CRM system for real estate, powered by n8n, LangChain, and GPT-4o-mini, featuring automated lead qualification, Egyptian dialect processing, PostgreSQL querying, and Human-in-the-Loop escalation.
projects.fullDescription:
### Overview
An end-to-end, omnichannel AI-powered CRM automation system built specifically for real estate agencies operating in the Egyptian market. The platform bridges customer communications across multiple messaging channels directly into a structured database with real-time AI decision-making.

### Key Features & Engineering Architecture
- **Omnichannel Integration:** Centralized message routing across WhatsApp (via Evolution API), Facebook Messenger, Instagram, and Telegram with native platform responses.
- **Agentic Workflows & Tool Calling:** Powered by n8n, LangChain, and GPT-4o-mini to dynamically query PostgreSQL databases, retrieve available real estate listings, and manage customer records without hardcoded scripts.
- **Data Normalization & NLP:** Intelligent processing of unstructured Egyptian dialect text and voice notes into standardized CRM data models (e.g., parsing "عايز شقة في التجمع" into APARTMENT and New Cairo).
- **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Safety:** Automated risk detection for financial commitments, down payments, or high-intent leads that pauses AI bot responses and immediately escalates the chat to a human agent via Telegram notifications.
- **Security & Validation:** Webhook payload verification and strict JSON schema validation for reliable database operations.
highlights: Built an omnichannel pipeline unifying WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, and Telegram into a single automated workflow.
Implemented Agentic AI with n8n, LangChain, and GPT-4o-mini for dynamic PostgreSQL database querying and listing retrieval.
Engineered NLP data normalization to convert Egyptian Arabic dialect text and voice notes into structured CRM records.
Designed Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) safety triggers for instant Telegram escalation on high-stakes or financial inquiries.
Integrated strict webhook verification, JSON schema validation, and multi-platform media handling (audio & image processing).

projects.title: Enterprise-Grade Restaurant Ordering & Omnichannel WhatsApp Automation Platform
projects.description: A resilient, production-ready full-stack ordering and workflow automation engine built with Next.js, Supabase RLS, and n8n, orchestrating real-time event-driven WhatsApp messaging via Evolution API.
projects.fullDescription:
Architected and deployed an end-to-end event-driven ordering ecosystem designed to transition traditional food and beverage outlets into operationally autonomous environments.

Key System Capabilities:
• Customer Portal: End-to-end transactional lifecycle management covering dynamic menu parsing, hybrid fulfillment routing (pickup vs. localized delivery), and idempotent order lifecycle tracking/cancellation.
• Merchant Operations Board: Real-time administrative control plane handling inventory categories, granular access policies, and dynamic delivery fee matrices.
• Event-Driven Automation Pipeline: Decentralized Webhook architecture dispatching distinct asynchronous events for order creation, state transitions, and cancellations.

Core Architecture & Tech Stack:
• Frontend & Backend Services: Next.js (Server Components, API Routes, App Router) hosted on Vercel.
• Data & Security Layer: Supabase PostgreSQL utilizing strict Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, session-based authentication, and atomic transactional integrity.
• Orchestration & Integration: n8n workflow engine executing modular sub-workflows, paired with a self-hosted Evolution API gateway for WhatsApp message routing.

Engineering Challenges Solved:
1. International Phone Normalization: Engineered a unified n8n sub-workflow applying regex-based validation and parsing for mixed regional number formats (Egyptian and Gulf numbering plans) to guarantee high message deliverability rates.
2. Idempotent Order State Management: Decoupled transactional state machines across Next.js and n8n webhooks to mitigate race conditions, duplicate dispatches, and split-brain scenarios during high-concurrency order surges.
3. Dynamic Fee Calculation Engine: Abstracted delivery pricing rules into configurable database parameters, ensuring deterministic mathematical calculation of subtotal, delivery tiers, and final taxable totals at checkout.
4. Modular Automation Design: Replaced brittle, monolithic scripting with reusable, composable n8n execution blocks, drastically lowering technical debt and simplifying debugging protocols.

Architectural Takeaway:
Automation is not an auxiliary feature; it is the core operational backbone that transforms a static digital storefront into a reliable, enterprise-ready business utility.
highlights: Event-driven webhook pipelines handling async state transitions.
Self-hosted Evolution API gateway for automated WhatsApp notifications.
Supabase PostgreSQL backed by strict Row-Level Security (RLS) policies.
